verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Haa-meem
Tanzeelul-kitaabi mina Allaahil-azeezil-hakeem
Maa khalaqnas-samaawaati wal-arda wa maa baynahumaa illaa bil-haqqi wa ajalin musamman wal-ladheena kafaroo ammaa undhiroo mu'ridoon
Qul ara'aytum maa tad'oona min doonillaahi aroonee maadhaa khalaqoo minal-ardi am lahum shirkun fis-samaawaati ii'toonee bikitaabin min qabli haadhaa aw athaaratin min ilmin in kuntum saadiqeen
Wa man adallu mimman yad'oo min doonillaahi man laa yastajeebu lahu ilaa yawmil-qiyaamati wa hum an du'aa'ihim ghaafiloon
Wa idhaa hushiran-naasu kaanoo lahum a'daa'an wa kaanoo bi-ibaadatihim kaafireen
Wa idhaa tutlaa alayhim aayaatunaa bayyinaatin qaalal-ladheena kafaroo lilhaqqi lammaa jaa'ahum haadhaa sihrun mubeen
Am yaqooloona iftaraahu qul inif-taraytuhu falaa tamlikoona lee mina Allaahi shay'an huwa a'lamu bimaa tufeedoona feehi kafaa bihi shaheedan baynee wa baynakum wa huwal-ghafoorur-Raheem
Qul maa kuntu bid'an minar-rusuli wa maa adree maa yuf'alu bee wa laa bikum in attabi'u illaa maa yoohaa ilayya wa maa anaa illaa nadheerun mubeen
Qul ara'aytum in kaana min indi Allaahi wa kafartum bihi wa shahida shaahidun min banee israa'eela alaa mithlihi fa-aamana wastakbartum innallaaha laa yahdil-qawmaz-zaalimeen
Wa qaalal-ladheena kafaroo lilladheena aamanoo law kaana khayran maa sabaqoonaa ilayhi wa idh lam yahtadoo bihi fasayaqooloona haadhaa ifkun qadeem
Wa min qablihi kitaabu moosaa imaaman wa rahmatan wa haadhaa kitaabun musaddiqun lisaanan arabiyyan liyundhiral-ladheena zalamoo wa bushraa lilmuhsineen
Innal-ladheena qaaloo rabbunaa Allaahu thumma istaqaamoo falaa khawfun alayhim wa laa hum yahzanoon
Ulaa'ika ashaabul-jannati khaalideena feehaa jazaa'an bimaa kaanoo ya'maloon

Wa wassaynal-insaana biwaalidayhi ihsaanan hamalathu ummuhu kurhan wa wada'athu kurhan wa hamluhu wa fisaaluhu thalaathoona shahran hattaa idhaa balagha ashuddahu wa balagha arba'eena sanatan qaala rabbi awzi'nee an ashkura ni'matakal-latee an'amta alayya wa alaa wa-dayya wa an a'mala saalihan tardaahu wa aslih lee fee dhurriyyatee innee tubtu ilayka wa innee minal-muslimeen
Ulaa'ikal-ladheena nataqabbalu anhum ahsana maa amiloo wa natajaawazu an sayyi'aatihim fee ashaabil-jannati wa'das-sidqil-ladhee kaanoo yoo'adoon

Wal-ladhee qaala liwaalidayhi uffin lakumaa ata'idaaninee an ukhraja wa qad khalatil-quroonu min qablee wa humaa yastagheethaani Allaaha waylaka aamin inna wa'da Allaahi haqqun fayaqoolu maa haadhaa illaa asaateerul-awwaleen
Ulaa'ikal-ladheena haqqa alayhimul-qawlu fee umamin qad khalat min qablihim minal-jinni wal-insi innahum kaanoo khaasireen
Wa likullin darajaatun mimmaa amiloo wa liyuwaffiyahum a'maalahum wa hum laa yuzlamoon

Wa yawma yu'radul-ladheena kafaroo alan-naari adhhabtum tayyibaatikum fee hayaatikumud-dunyaa wastamta'tum bihaa fal-yawma tujzawna adhaabal-hooni bimaa kuntum tastakbiroona fil-ardi bighayril-haqqi wa bimaa kuntum tafsuqoon
Wadhkur akhaa aadin idh andhara qawmahu bil-ahqaafi wa qad khalatin-nudhuru min bayni yadayhi wa min khalfihi allaa ta'budoo illaa Allaaha innee akhaafu alaykum adhaaba yawmin azeem
Qaaloo aji'tanaa lita'fikanaa an aalihatinaa fa'tinaa bimaa ta'idunaa in kunta minas-saadiqeen
Qaala innamal-ilmu indallaahi wa uballighukum maa ursiltu bihi wa laakinnee araakum qawman tajhaloon
Falammaa ra'awhu aaridan mustaqbila awdiyatihim qaaloo haadhaa aaridun mumtirunaa bal huwa mas-ta'jaltum bihi reehun feehaa adhaabun aleem
Tudammiru kulla shay'in bi-amri rabbihaa fa-asbahoo laa yuraa illaa masaakinuhum kadhaalika najzil-qawmal-mujrimeen

Wa laqad makkannaahum feemaa in makkannaakum feehi wa ja'alnaa lahum sam'an wa absaaran wa af'idatan famaa aghnaa anhum sam'uhum wa laa absaaruhum wa laa af'idatuhum min shay'in idh kaanoo yajhadoona bi-aayaati Allaahi wa haaqa bihim maa kaanoo bihi yastahzi'oon
Wa laqad ahlaknaa maa hawlakum minal-quraa wa sarrafnal-aayaati la-allahum yarji'oon
Falawlaa nasarahumul-ladheena ittakhadhoo min doonillaahi qurbaanan aalihatan bal dalloo anhum wa dhaalika ifkuhum wa maa kaanoo yaftaroon
Wa idh sarafnaa ilayka nafaran minal-jinni yastami'oonal-qur'aana falammaa hadaroohu qaaloo ansitoo falammaa qudiya wallaw ilaa qawmihim mundhireen
Qaaloo yaa qawmanaa innaa sami'naa kitaaban unzila min ba'di moosaa musaddiqan limaa bayna yadayhi yahdee ilal-haqqi wa ilaa tareeqin mustaqeem
Yaa qawmanaa ajeeboo daa'iya Allaahi wa aaminoo bihi yaghfir lakum min dhunoobikum wa yujirkum min adhaabin aleem
Wa man laa yujib daa'iya Allaahi falaysa bimu'jizin fil-ardi wa laysa lahu min doonihi awliyaa'u ulaa'ika fee dalaalin mubeen
Awalam yaraw annallaahal-ladhee khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda wa lam ya'ya bikhalqihinna biqaadirin alaa an yuhyiyal-mawtaa balaa innahu alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Wa yawma yu'radul-ladheena kafaroo alan-naari alaysa haadhaa bil-haqqi qaaloo balaa wa rabbinaa qaala fadhooqul-adhaaba bimaa kuntum takfuroon
Fasbir kamaa sabara ulul-azmi minar-rusuli wa laa tasta'jil lahum ka'annahum yawma yarawna maa yoo'adoona lam yalbathoo illaa saa'atan min nahaarin balaaghun fahal yuhlaku illal-qawmul-faasiqoon
